Messages.Author: Madman2001
Messages.Body:
Folks:

There are many cards which say "pay an extra blood when . . ", for
example Terror Frenzy which, at superior, says "Opposing minion pays an
additional blood when playing combat cards during this combat." My
understanding is, however, that this has an effect *only* if the minion
*has* blood. For example, let's say that Koko was in a Terror Frenzy
and had zero blood. However, I suspect that s/he could still play all
sorts of cards like Immortal Grapple, Torn Signpost, etc. etc. without
effect. Am I right??

Compel the Spirit states that it is "only usable if a retainer or ally
you control has been burned since your last turn". Presumably this
would cover any such event during the *present* turn. Let's say that
Talaq foolishly rushed another minion and was burned. Gloria Giovanni
could then immediately use Compel the Spirit to return the Talaq card
to my hand, right??

Thanks in advance,
Madman

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Fri, 24 Mar 2000, Madman2001 wrote:
> There are many cards which say "pay an extra blood when . . ", for
> example Terror Frenzy which, at superior, says "Opposing minion pays an
> additional blood when playing combat cards during this combat." My
> understanding is, however, that this has an effect *only* if the minion
> *has* blood. For example, let's say that Koko was in a Terror Frenzy
> and had zero blood. However, I suspect that s/he could still play all
> sorts of cards like Immortal Grapple, Torn Signpost, etc. etc. without
> effect. Am I right??

If it was burn additional blood, you would be correct.

Howevre, it adds to the payment for the card, which is deemed to be zero
blood. (There would be an argument to be had that the card cost no blood,
and so couldn't be modified, but that is a different argument.) However,
the cost of Lucky BLow is now 1 blood. If Koko has 0 blood, the 1 blood
for Lucky Blow is unaffordable, and so the card cannot be played.

>
> Compel the Spirit states that it is "only usable if a retainer or ally
> you control has been burned since your last turn". Presumably this
> would cover any such event during the *present* turn.

Yes.

But if, say, that retainer was burned this turn, you couldn't compel
them next term, since it only covres cards burned *since* your last turn.

> Let's say that
> Talaq foolishly rushed another minion and was burned. Gloria Giovanni
> could then immediately use Compel the Spirit to return the Talaq card
> to my hand, right??

Yes.

Of course, you're btter off playing it with superior Necromancy if you can
- it moves the ally into play without paying their cost.

--

James Coupe

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Madman2001 wrote:
>
> Folks:

>
> There are many cards which say "pay an extra blood when . . ", for
> example Terror Frenzy which, at superior, says "Opposing minion pays an
> additional blood when playing combat cards during this combat." My
> understanding is, however, that this has an effect *only* if the minion
> *has* blood. For example, let's say that Koko was in a Terror Frenzy
> and had zero blood. However, I suspect that s/he could still play all
> sorts of cards like Immortal Grapple, Torn Signpost, etc. etc. without
> effect. Am I right??

Short answer: yes.

Long answer:
Terror Frenzy uses "pay" indicating a cost, and "when" indicating that
it is not a cost. I'd go with your reading - the extra blood is just
burned. It isn't an increase in the cost of the card. (i.e., treat
"pays" as "burns" in this case, rather than treating "when playing"
as "to play".)

> Compel the Spirit states that it is "only usable if a retainer or ally
> you control has been burned since your last turn". Presumably this

> would cover any such event during the *present* turn. Let's say that

> Talaq foolishly rushed another minion and was burned. Gloria Giovanni
> could then immediately use Compel the Spirit to return the Talaq card
> to my hand, right??

Yes.
